purpose: Machine-readable chronology of major IsoGraph and Project Discovery ideas, formulations, mission changes, and contribution boundaries. Entries state earliest evidence currently located; they are not global priority determinations.

entries.title: Agent-oriented compact reasoning representation / context-logic incubation

conversation_evidence.summary: Stated that the language was for agents, emphasizing context-window compactness and synthesis of concepts.

reasoning_path: Complex reasoning can exceed available context/working-state capacity even when local operations are tractable.
A compact state should preserve propositions, dependencies, scopes, alternatives, provenance, and inference obligations.
History may be quotiented only when valid future continuations remain unchanged.
The first public Axiomesh record therefore framed a search for a token-efficient, recoverable logical/structural state for agents.
entries.notes: The seed README explicitly says 'Research direction: Josh Oshiro'. 'Josh Oshiro' is the historical short-form name for Joshua Oshiro.

entries.title: Graph/hypergraph rewrite substrate and structure-plus-transformation formulation

attribution.detail: Adopted the proposal as a candidate research direction and continued directing its development.

earliest_evidence.summary: Assistant proposed graph/hypergraph rewriting as a candidate substrate and the formulation of knowledge as structure plus lawful transformation.

reasoning_path: The initial Markov-like sufficient-state idea had to preserve nonlocal dependencies, guards, quantifiers, alternatives, and provenance.
The design pressure favored a sparse typed relational structure over a simple chain.
Graph/hypergraph rewriting unified represented state and lawful transformation while supporting composition, self-representation, isomorphism, and residual accounting.
entries.notes: This record deliberately does not attribute the graph/hypergraph-rewrite proposal or the compact structure-plus-transformation wording solely to Joshua Oshiro.

entries.title: One semantic structure / no mandatory internal translation boundary
reasoning_path: A translator between a source formalism and a separate agent formalism would confound representation, decomposition, mapping, and translation loss.
The project therefore made the structural form both semantic representation and native wire representation, with human/theorem-prover/database views downstream.
entries.notes: The surviving evidence establishes the design under Joshua's research direction but does not support clean sole-origin attribution for this exact formulation.

public_evidence.description: Standalone migration of the AxiomeSH corpus.
Completed IsoGraph naming migration without semantic change.

entries.title: Observation-first discrepancy handling: error/defect may be a clue

conversation_evidence.summary: Stated that a discrepancy might be a clue to look deeper rather than something to normalize away immediately.
Accepted and reinforced an observation-first posture: anomalies should be understood before judging or repairing them.
Strengthened the rule: discrepancies/errors should be preserved and investigated as possible clues; even the expected/reference authority may be wrong.
Clarified that concrete examples normally express a general principle, not a request for a special-case rule.

reasoning_path: Unexpected mismatch may indicate a bug, hidden distinction, hidden equivalence, wrong reference expectation, scope mismatch, or unresolved structure.
Therefore preserve the observation before assigning defect ownership.
When repair is justified, use it as a diagnostic intervention and see what disappears or survives.
Keep repair disposition separate from discovery disposition.

reasoning_path: High-level names can conceal exactly the structure needed for discovery.
A source-faithful representation may retain convenient labels only as derived/reconstructible views.
Definitionally reducible semantics should not remain opaque authoritative leaves.

entries.title: Woit-Lisi IsoGraph structural comparison campaign

earliest_evidence.summary: Joshua identified Peter Woit's and Garrett Lisi's programs as candidates for an IsoGraph isomorph search and directed that the work receive its own research directory.

entries.title: Mandatory intra-author formulation-family recovery before cross-domain bridge selection

earliest_evidence.summary: Joshua observed that Woit and Lisi often use multiple formulations of the same ideas, not all equally translatable, and directed the campaign to identify same-author alternative expressions and determine which representatives bridge most strongly in each direction.

reasoning_path: A one-rendering-per-author comparison can create false negatives when the chosen representatives expose different structure.
It can also create false positives if a convenient representative cannot be transported back through the author's other formulations.
Therefore recover same-author formulation families blindly before cross-domain comparison.
Treat representative preference as bridge-objective-relative and evidence-bounded rather than as a globally canonical formulation.

public_formalization.note: Formalized in the same work cycle as this provenance entry.

entries.title: Full independent IsoGraph treatment of both Woit and Lisi programs before cross-domain comparison

earliest_evidence.summary: Joshua directed that both theories receive the full IsoGraph treatment, not merely bridge-sufficient partial renderings.

consequence: Each author becomes an independent full-treatment research track.
Full SSC, primitive closure, recursive IA, NEI, DTS, DP, reconstruction, and sealing are required independently.
Cross-author comparison becomes downstream of the two sealed treatments.

public_formalization.note: Formalized in the same work cycle.

entries.title: Isomorph-exposure frontier for axiomatic abstraction

earliest_evidence.summary: Joshua identified the abstraction boundary as a discovery variable: abstract far enough to expose likely isomorphic generative structures, but not so far that load-bearing distinctions are erased.

reasoning_path: The source mathematical objects are too large for extensional IsoGraph representation.
An axiomatic representation is therefore required.
Too-concrete axioms hide cross-formulation structure; too-abstract axioms create trivial false correspondences.
Use nested source-preserving abstractions and stop at the deepest nontrivial common quotient that still reconstructs the relevant source views.

entries.title: Guess-test qualification with retained hypothesis-origin authority provenance

attribution.detail: Clarified that informed guessing is lawful discovery when derivation runs out, that a guess is not authority, that successful testing/qualification can make the exact result usable authority within its earned scope, and that its hypothesis origin should remain permanently visible rather than being laundered into indistinguishable authority.

Formalized the distinction as explicit HYPOTHESIS_CANDIDATE and HYPOTHESIS_QUALIFIED provenance states, a guess-test-qualify-consume sequence, retained adaptive/test lineage, and a Graph-First Method 0.3 successor.

earliest_evidence.summary: Joshua explicitly distinguished lawful guess-and-test discovery from authority promotion, then directed that a successfully tested hypothesis remain tagged by its hypothesis/test provenance even when promoted for current scoped use.

reasoning_path: Current qualified deduction can reach a material residual without proving irreducibility.
A lawful next step is to generate a provisional hypothesis inside the active information firewall.
The hypothesis earns no authority merely by being plausible or useful.
Predictions, falsifiers, controls, and sufficiently strong confirmation determine whether the exact revision earns promotion.
Promotion grants authority only within the qualification contract.
The record permanently retains that the authority originated as a hypothesis and how it was tested.
Later stronger derivation may replace or strengthen the authority basis without erasing the earlier provenance.
consequence: A G5/current-authority fixed point is not interpreted as a prohibition on further hypothesis-driven discovery.
HYPOTHESIS_QUALIFIED may be used as provenance/qualification metadata but is not a new Core truth value or primitive.
Downstream claims may consume an explicitly promoted hypothesis-derived revision within its qualified scope and must retain dependency provenance.
Failed hypotheses remain negative/discovery evidence rather than being silently discarded or promoted.
Already-qualified DP 0.10 and EI 0.1 bytes remain immutable; this clarification composes with them rather than retroactively rewriting them.
